players.espn_source_reported_injury_detail: Barnes (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Jackson-Davis is out for Thursday's game against the 76ers due to an illness.
Youngblood (foot) is out for Friday's game against Sacramento.
Hayes won't return to Friday's game against the Rockets due to a left knee issue.
Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Reaves (heel) won't undergo imaging and is considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game against the Suns, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.
Head coach JJ Redick said Friday that Doncic (ankle) is "fine," per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Grimes (finger) said he expects to return to action Sunday against the Suns, according to Ricardo Sandoval of Lakers on SI.
Sexton did not return to Wednesday's 123-112 win over the Bucks and required stitches to close a cut on his forehead, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.
Miller (groin) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Phoenix.
Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
